title: A Means to an End
description: Lurking in the dark has punishing consequences
body:
# End Sickness
The plauge that doesnt go away after drinking milk. Stepping out of light causes you to get more and more sick, making you lose your strength, vision, satiated, and enventually, your sanity. When you lose your santiy, you go to the end, and cannot escape untill you are sane enough.

## The Cure
The cure is simple, a stew made out of golden carrots and apples with a sunflower to compliment it. The Golden Apple Stew is the only way to rid of End Sickness, as the sickness is persistant to your name.

## The Infection Process
End Sickness can be brewed easily by dropping an Eye of Ender into a potion of Weakness and letting it brew, allowing you to conquer up the Dark Brew. This brew can be used as a Splash Potion to infect your friends and foes. The sickness can also be stacked, making the sickness tick faster untill the player respawns.

Have Fun :)
